notes: «عن أبيه» is a second route from Hisham (through his father) with no saying of its own; the text writes no names to repeat for it, so it is not read as a route here.
Asma is the last link: her words to Ibn al-Zubayr («يا بنى إنهم يعيرونك») are the saying relayed by Wahb.
«قال كان أهل الشأم» is Wahb's narration of the scene, not a transmitter.
